title: Mergers and Acquisitions Trends in the Global Property and Casualty Insurance Industry
关键词: China Taiping Insurance Holdings Company Limited
主要内容: In 2013, M&A activity in the P&C insurance industry saw a decline in deal volume but an increase in average deal value. Improved industry performance, renewed investor confidence, better reserves, and the start of a hard market cycle (with higher premiums) contributed to this trend. The year also had fewer catastrophic losses than previous years, enhancing merger prospects globally. European P&C insurers were restructuring globally and active in outbound deals, especially in the Middle East and Africa. Asia-Pacific, Latin America, and the Caribbean saw domestic merger activity as developed insurers sought to strengthen distribution in low-penetration markets. Notable deals included Jabez Partners acquiring Green non-life insurance co. ltd for $X million and The Travelers Companies purchasing The Dominion of Canada General Insurance company for $X million. Active buyers included the US, UK, Bermuda, Canada, Germany, France, Russia, Australia, Japan, and Spain, with sectors such as property and casualty insurance, insurance brokers, and reinsurance being prominent.

股票实体.名称: China Taiping Insurance Holdings Company Limited
